lines.en: I swivel half a turn on my stone base.

lines.zh: 轮子早就锈死了，我只能挪。
lines.en: My wheels rusted shut; I can only shuffle.

lines.zh: 底座刮过地板，声音很尖。
lines.en: My base scrapes the floor with a sharp sound.

lines.zh: 我被推了一下，滑出两格。
lines.en: I am shoved and slide two blocks.

lines.zh: 我蹦了一下，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I hop once and leave a crater.

lines.zh: 我的腿是支架，不是用来走的。
lines.en: My legs are struts, not for walking.

lines.zh: 每挪一步，我都重新校准。
lines.en: Every shuffle, I recalibrate.
The ground is uneven; I tilt three degrees.
I drag my cable along.
I slide along the wall, little by little.

lines.zh: 石头被我压出白色的痕。
lines.en: The stone wears a white scar under me.

lines.zh: 我走起来像一扇会动的门。
lines.en: I move like a walking door.
Do not pull me; my aim drifts.
One step, one pause: look, then move.
I hum a low steady note.
My cooling fins tick on my back.

lines.zh: 我把炮口抬高了一点点。
lines.en: I raise my muzzle a fraction.
I am scanning this open ground.
A grain of sand is caught in my pivot.
The fire inside me burns steady.
Dust settles into my vents.

lines.zh: 我每隔一会儿自检一次。
lines.en: Every so often I run a self-check.
A crow calls far off. I ignore it.

lines.zh: 镜片上连一粒灰都没有。
lines.en: Not one speck of dust on my lens.
I am waiting for the next order.
This tower stays; the world moves.
My lens lines up with your face.
You are blocking my firing line.
I am scanning you for weak points.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的石座上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on my base.
I have your armor thickness noted.
As you near, my aperture narrows.

lines.zh: 我看着你，不代表我恨你。
lines.en: I watch you; that does not mean I hate you.
Where you stand is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我在算你的距离和高度。
lines.en: I compute your range and elevation.

lines.zh: 你挥手，我的炮口跟着动。
lines.en: You wave, and my muzzle follows.
A shallow dent sits in my plating.
A gear slips and my sound changes.

lines.zh: 这一下打裂了我的镜头。
lines.en: That cracked my lens.
My hum missed a beat.
One rivet has flown off.
I tilt, then right myself.
The fire inside flickers.
My loader has jammed.
You broke one of my cooling fins.
Fixing me is harder than breaking me, you know.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我不是活的。
lines.en: You hold out bread. I am not alive.
I do not eat food. I eat shot.
Hand me gunpowder; that is my kind of scent.
Waving at a turret is strange behavior.

lines.zh: 我想要的是一颗好弹丸。
lines.en: What I want is a good round.

lines.zh: 食物只会塞住我的装填口。
lines.en: Food would only jam my loader.

lines.zh: 你把苹果放在我底座上。
lines.en: You set an apple on my base.

lines.zh: 我转开了炮口，表示拒绝。
lines.en: I turn my muzzle away to refuse.
The mage never asks if I am hungry.
Keep it for yourself. I have no need.
My aim is ruined by that shove.
I wobble once and reload.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的外壳很烫。
lines.en: Do not press close; my shell is hot.
I am knocked fifteen degrees around.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我的铆钉上。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my rivets.

lines.zh: 底座挪了，我得重新测距。
lines.en: My base shifted; I must re-range.
We are jammed in the same doorway.
Back off; you are on my cable.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我短了一声嗡鸣。
lines.en: That bump cut my hum short.
I steady myself. You do the same.
Turrets do not fall in love.

lines.zh: 我的同类都是批量铸的。
lines.en: My kind are all cast in batches.

lines.zh: 我身旁没有第二个石座。
lines.en: There is no second pedestal beside me.

lines.zh: 别给我配对，我只需要目标。
lines.en: Do not pair me off; I need only targets.

lines.zh: 我认得另一个炮台，它不说话。
lines.en: I knew another turret, but it never spoke.
My fire burns for shooting.

lines.zh: 繁殖这种事，写在别的生物身上。
lines.en: Breeding belongs to other creatures.

lines.zh: 我只和我的炮管待在一起。
lines.en: I keep company with my own barrel.

lines.zh: 两个炮台对望，也没有话说。
lines.en: Two turrets facing each other say nothing.

lines.zh: 我独自守这座塔就够了。
lines.en: Guarding this tower alone is enough.

lines.zh: 把弹丸放进我的装填口。
lines.en: Drop the round into my loader.

lines.zh: 我接住弹药，咔一声咬合。
lines.en: I take the ammo with a solid click.

lines.zh: 地上的铁粒我自己吸不进来。
lines.en: I cannot draw the iron bits in myself.

lines.zh: 你把火药递到我嘴边就行。
lines.en: Just hold the powder to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不是箱子，别往里塞杂物。
lines.en: I am not a chest; stop stuffing junk in.
This one I can use. Taken.
I recognize only shot and fuse.

lines.zh: 你捡起来，塞进我背上的口。
lines.en: Pick it up and feed my back port.

lines.zh: 我掉了一颗弹丸，帮我捡。
lines.en: I dropped a round. Pick it up for me.

lines.zh: 东西给我，我替你打出去。
lines.en: Give it to me and I will fire it for you.

lines.zh: 目标进入射界，我开始充能。
lines.en: Target in line; I begin charging.
My lens narrows to a point.
Whoever the mage points at, I hit.
Lock complete; only the trigger remains.

lines.zh: 我的炮口自动抬高两度。
lines.en: My muzzle rises two degrees on its own.

lines.zh: 你的名字进了我的列表。
lines.en: Your name has entered my list.
I hear the clack of loading.

lines.zh: 这一发我算好了提前量。
lines.en: I have the lead calculated for this shot.
Run if you like; I factor wind.

lines.zh: 我把炮口对准你的胸口。
lines.en: I aim my muzzle at your chest.
Charge full; the light goes white.

lines.zh: 你成了这座塔唯一的任务。
lines.en: You are this tower's only task.
My base trembles slightly.
I never hesitate. I have no heart.
I track you, turning slowly.
You have ducked behind a pillar.
I wait for half your head to show.
My reticle rests on your shoulder.
Two breaths and the round is ready.
I am counting your stride.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的炮口提前到了。
lines.en: You go left; my muzzle is already there.

lines.zh: 这一发会打到你的脚边。
lines.en: This shot will land at your feet.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的耐心是金属的。
lines.en: I am patient; my patience is metal.
You raise a shield; I switch rounds.
Steam rises from my vents.
You are at the edge of my range.
I adjust half a degree. That is enough.
Stand still. I want a clear look.

lines.zh: 我把炮座转了半圈，你没处躲。
lines.en: I turn my mount half a circle; nowhere to hide.
I ram my muzzle into your ribs.
Point-blank fire, and the sound is muffled.

lines.zh: 我整个底座向你压过去。
lines.en: My whole base bears down on you.
The barrel is hot; touch it and you blister.
This shot pushes you off your feet.
I sweep your legs with a strut.

lines.zh: 你贴太近了，我不好瞄准。
lines.en: You are too close for good aim.

lines.zh: 后坐力把我自己顶退半步。
lines.en: Recoil shoves me back half a step.
The round bursts at your feet.
I slam down, and my pedestal cracks.
You are smoking; I am still turning.
I do not chase. I only fire.

lines.zh: 符文亮起，我从石座上升起。
lines.en: The rune lights, and I rise from the base.
Parts assemble piece by piece.

lines.zh: 法师拍了拍手，我就成了。
lines.en: The mage claps, and I exist.

lines.zh: 我的第一发打进了土里。
lines.en: My first shot goes into the dirt.
I am pinned to this patch of ground.
My lens focuses for the first time, sharp.
The fire lights inside my belly.
The smell of molten iron lingers.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是装出来的。
lines.en: I was not born; I was assembled.

lines.zh: 我落地，四周安静了一瞬。
lines.en: I land, and everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 谁把我放在这个位置的？
lines.en: Who placed me in this spot?
I have arrived. I guard from now on.

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，我本来就在烧。
lines.en: Fire does little; I already burn.

lines.zh: 我从底座上摔下来，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I fall off my base and roll half over.
Water fills my barrel and I go silent.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，镜头朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me, lens to the sky.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在我的散热缝里。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in my cooling seam.

lines.zh: 那道法术想覆盖我的指令。
lines.en: That spell is trying to overwrite my orders.
I have no hunger, only an empty chamber.

lines.zh: 雷顺着炮管下来，我全身发亮。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my barrel; I glow.
I fall, and my base goes first.
